hero.lead: We imagine, build and run our own digital products, designed for everyday life in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

about.p1: Start from the real needs of people here and design solutions that are simple, useful and beautiful.
about.p2: An in-house technical team that develops our apps, servers and tools, end to end.
about.p3: We run our products ourselves, every day, and improve them alongside the people who use them.
about.lead: MINDSET ALLIANCE SARL is a company based in Kinshasa. We are not an agency: we design, develop and run our own digital products, from the idea to the daily life of the people who use them. Colis na Nga and Mindset du Royaume are the first; more are on the way.

cnn.f1: Live GPS tracking of every trip
cnn.f2: Handover confirmed by code, signature or photo
cnn.f4: Partner riders from associations, and company couriers for subscribed customers
cnn.lead: The app to send letters and light parcels anywhere in Kinshasa, in a few taps.
cnn.stores: Android and iOS: coming soon to the stores

products.title: What we build
products.lead: Each product answers a real need. Together, they form the alliance.

mdr.lead: The Mindset Alliance YouTube channel: videos to share ideas and feed the mindset that drives us.

next.title: And what’s next…
next.lead: More products are being prepared in our workshops. Stay tuned.

approach.a1: Mobile Money, Kinshasa addresses and landmarks, French, English, Lingala and Swahili: our products speak the language of the people who use them.
approach.a2: Our developers work together on every product, from the mobile app to the server.
approach.a3: Controlled access, protected data, every important action logged.
approach.a4: MA Workspace, our internal console, brings our products and teams together in one place.
